mapper.sql: audit_id, trace_id, event_type, actor, client_ip, http_method, request_uri, target_id, params, result, error_code, error_message, elapsed_ms, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log ( trace_id, event_type, actor, client_ip, http_method, request_uri, target_id, params, result, error_code, error_message, elapsed_ms, created_at ) VALUES ( #{traceId}, #{eventType}, #{actor}, #{clientIp}, #{httpMethod}, #{requestUri}, #{targetId}, #{params}, #{result}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{elapsedMs}, now() )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM audit_log WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} ORDER BY audit_id
